description: A2 (c220) KDA chunk forward: gate, scores, blocked triangular inverse, WY and chunk recurrence, re-authored from the A5 stable unit for the A2 facade (tile-vector UB ops instead of @vf, GM workspace rings instead of UB->L1 / L0C->UB). Public inputs/outputs are token-major and read / written by the kernels directly; the host only allocates and takes views.

domain.block_dim_note: Only 1 and 2 have been run on the A2 device (bd1 and bd2 outputs bitwise equal). The A5 upper bound 4 is not inherited (AGENTS.md section 6).

gate_span.note: The A5 stable limits (forward 155, finite to 174.7) are A5 measurements and are not inherited. The arithmetic is the same midpoint-anchored form, so the same analysis applies, but the A2 gate must be re-measured (A2-12).

domain.accumulate_settle: Every L0C accumulate chain carries an explicit barrier(Pipe.M) (A2-01 / ascriptor M10-081); the BF16/FP16 splitk form is not used.

support.note: All 20 cases were run on an Ascend 910B3 (CANN 9.0.0) through the aclnn launcher and matched their budgets (evidence/unit/aclnn.json). They are recorded as observations: AGENTS.md section 2 says an A2 number is not an operator conclusion before A2-11, so this row stays untested.

derived_from.note: gate/intra/wy/recurrent come from this repository's A5 stable unit; the inverse from ascriptor a5.kda_fwd (read-only). Arithmetic and precision boundaries are unchanged; the form is rewritten for A2.

changes: No @vf on A2: every vector body is tile-vector UB ops, per-row scalars via Var.GetValueFrom.
No dma.ub_to_l1 / dma.l0c_to_ub on device b3: every cross-side handoff is a two-slot GMBuff ring indexed by one beat, guarded by VcMutex (MTE3->MTE2) or CvMutex (FIX->MTE2).
No FP32 L0C->L1 on c220: the inverse publishes its FP32 products through a GM workspace with an explicit FIX->MTE2 DEvent (autosync does not order a same-core GM read-after-write).
The recurrence uses auto_sync instead of 31 hand-placed events; the A5K-01 Aqk slot rotation is not needed (Aqk is loaded per chunk into a cube-local buffer).
Public q/k/v/g_raw/beta are read and o is written token-major; casts, scale and the GQA head map are in-kernel.
Explicit barrier(Pipe.M) before every is_init=False accumulate (inverse FP32 chains, recurrence BF16 output chain).

workspace.lifetime: Per invocation; stage outputs ordered by the five kernel launches.
workspace.gm_rings: Per kernel, two-slot GMBuff rings in the launch workspace (scores: qg/kbg/kgneg/Aqk/strict; inverse: diag01/diag23/pub; wy: abeta/kexp; recurrence: h/qg/vnew/prod/delta).

saved_state.final_state: FP32 key-major state [B, HV, 128, 128]; no new backward checkpoint.
